title: OOPALGORITHM2 External Calibration App Features
symptom: Users who install the OOP2 decoding apk for Libre 2 are presented with a message asking "OOPALGORITHM2 use app for calibration" when using for the first time and periodically afterwards. If they answer "yes" they will not be able to read the Libre 2 via Bluetooth which is the primary use case for OOP2.
cause: The message is erroneous and induces users to make a wrong choice, as OOP2 is not a calibration algorithm.
fix: A pull request (https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/1835) was created to fix this problem.
evidence_quote: This message appear to me to be erroneous, as it induces users to make a wrong choice (at least in the majority of cases) and in any case OOP2 is _not_ a calibration algorithm.
